summary: A resampling sound-design instrument: build a sound from a source, modulation and an effects chain, resample it, and use the result as the next source. Each saved sound keeps the recipe that made it.
features: Sources: 4-op FM, analog, drums, and resamples as sample, grain or chop
6 LFOs and 3 envelopes, four destinations each; up to 8 effects
64-sound bank with generation trees and bit-exact rebuild
Four tracks, chord sequences, chords by degree and a chord-following arp
USB MIDI clock in or out and note output; USB audio
Resamples limited to 1.67 s; pitch not yet a modulation target

headings: build, install, test on the hardware
